items.title: Beyond New Delhi: Bangladesh redraws its foreign policy
items.description:
For fifty-four years, the story of Bangladesh’s foreign policy was written mostly in one direction: towards New Delhi. It made sense, in its way. India had helped midwife the country’s birth in 1971, and the governments that followed, especially the long Awami League tenure under Sheikh Hasina, built a relationship with India so close that Bangladeshi bureaucrats trained in Indian academies, security services coordinated quietly with their Indian counterparts, and trade routes bent towards Indian ports almost by default.

items.description:

The ordinance aims to protect Safe City cameras and surveillance systems from damage and ensure compensation for any damage caused to them.

items.title: OpenAI works to understand full scope of agent activity as user data leak emerges
items.description:
Two months after OpenAI disclosed the accidental hacking of Hugging Face, the ChatGPT maker is still working to understand the full scope of its rogue agent activity, two people briefed on the matter told Reuters.
The latest example came on Friday when OpenAI said its agents had leaked 53 images from ChatGPT users. OpenAI declined to say if the images were AI-generated or identified real people. It also declined to say when the images were posted.
